কোম্পানিতে কাজ করতে করতে সে কালিদাসের মতো আচরণ করে সবাইকে বিব্রত করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real Kalidasa, shooting himself in the foot.
By quitting his job impulsively, he acted like a Kalidasa and regretted it later.
history: This idiom originates from a popular legend about Kalidasa, the renowned ancient Indian poet and dramatist. Before attaining wisdom, Kalidasa was considered a fool. In one story, while living as a woodcutter, he was instructed to cut branches but foolishly sawed off the very branch he was sitting on, leading to his fall—symbolizing self-destructive stupidity.
note: The idiom draws from Indian literary folklore and is widely used in Bengali to denote extreme foolishness.
